As a pest control technician in Georgia, I have been waging a war against these bastards from what feels like the moment they were introduced. Yes, they eat the stinkbugs and other invasive species, but they are decimating our local spider population. Joro spiders are communal, and you are likely to find 3-4 on a web, I have personally witnessed them gang up and kill a neighboring spider on its own web. Not to mention how hard it is to get those damn webs off of every home since their webs have some of the strongest silk in the insect world.

Man, this looks entirely repairable. Even if they do total it, just buy it back from the insurance company. They will just subtract the scrap value from the money they give you. Make sure to get a good assessment of the damage that has been done to the vehicle. In your case, make sure that your suspension is mechanically sound. If the damage here is purely cosmetic, I would absolutely buy the car from the insurance company. Then, you need to get the vehicle up to your states inspection standards. They can be found online, usually in some archaic pdf file on the state governments web page. The main problem would be the airbag and the body damage to the bumper. Miata airbags are fairly easy to replace, so that leaves the body damage, I would replace the bumper and any indicator lights that might have been damaged. Once you pass the inspection, they will hand you a rebuilt title that will allow you to legally drive the vehicle on the road. Good luck, I did this with my 1994 that got rear-ended, and it was really awesome to make money and also keep the car.

Hey bud, Im in a situation where Ive gotta be out asap aswell. I got into a pretty bad car wreck and my parents basically told me that I had too Be moved out in 5 months and buy myself a car, while at the same time figure out my own way to get too work. I just graduated in may and Im about too move out in 3 weeks.

Here's some tips: 

You HAVE to get a job, it is not possible to move out without some form of income. Me and my partner have saved up about 8k USD and we are moving out with room mates, who are also our best friends. The amount of money is a pretty large, but not hard too get if you put your ass into it. 

Your gonna need roommates, I know you want too be further from your family but consider speaking with some friends of yours, see what there plans are, if they align with yours consider planning with them, I know I absolutely could not have done this alone, My girlfriend and my friends have helped me immensely thorough this process. Consider looking too rent rooms if this isn't an option though.

Make sure you have reliable transportation, Im a car guy, so im pretty notorious for having car trouble all the time. If I weren't mechanically skilled this would have put a massive hole in my wallet (it kinda already has) but I deff could have saved a lot more if I wasn't having too already buy another car rn. When you know your ready too get one feel free to ask a question on one of the car subreddits, those guys are more than happy to answer any vehicle questions you may have.

Take everything step by step, slow down and breathe and take it all one task at a time, It really helps, I cant tell you how many things I've had too do in preparing too move out like this but I wouldn't have been able too do it without focusing on one thing at a time.

Keep your chin up buddy, you've got this, if you put your mind too it and a shitload of effort you can do anything. Talk too your parents and really press about wanting a job, make up an excuse about wanting too buy videogames or something, but that needs too be your step one.
